ValidationRule.description: Prevent status can only from Draft other than Under Review. Status can only changed to Under Review from Draft Status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT( PRIORVALUE( CLA_Status__c ) ) = 'Draft' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Under Review' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Draft')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can only changed to Under Review from Draft Status.
